## Sources and definitions

Synergy Sports (Synergy web app API), Serie A games of the 2026-27 season up to 2026-11-09, pulled 15 Nov 2026; folder `data/synergy/key_numbers_virtus-bologna_2026-11-22`. Based solely on the data: no comments on plays.

* **Ranks**: among the 16 Serie A teams; ties share the rank. Defense ranks: 1st = allows the least.
* **At the rim**: 2-point attempts within 6 ft of the basket. **Points in the paint**: field goals only (no free throws).
* **Open**: catch-and-shoot jumpers that Synergy tags as open (it tags open / guarded only on catch-and-shoot jumpers).
* **Shots after a drive**: field-goal attempts whose Synergy description contains a drive (Drives Left / Right / Straight).
* **Offensive rebound %**: offensive rebounds / (offensive + opponent defensive rebounds), from Synergy's play-by-play stats.
* **Defenders**: possessions that end on the defender (Synergy's defensive player), so small samples.
* Not in Synergy (tracking only): box-outs, blow-bys, closeouts, crashing the glass, passes per chance, pick-and-roll coverages.
